options.name: accept_license
options.description: Whether to accept the license for the package(s).

options.name: name
options.description: One or more packages to install or remove. Use V(all) to install all packages available on informed O(repository_path).

options.name: repository_path
options.description: Path with AIX packages (required to install).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the package needs to be present on or absent from the system.
